payload.detail: RECHECKED 2026-09-25: no dates added. The cloud session's network egress refuses every publisher host (wa.gov.au, mhc.wa.gov.au, aihw.gov.au, ruah.org.au, youthfocus.com.au, passages.org.au, healthdirect.gov.au and others all returned connect_rejected on 2026-09-25), and the sources skill forbids taking a publisher, date or contact detail from anywhere but the publisher's own page, so this cannot be done from a cloud session. TO UNBLOCK: run it from an unrestricted network, for example a Remote Control session on the owner's PC, or have the owner approve each page fetch. Never infer a date from a search summary. The 'publisher registered, date still required' blocker applies to 12 sources, not 17. The count of 21 needing a date is correct. None of the 41 carries a publication or review date in the handover. Seventeen have a publisher that is now registered and need only a date read from the publisher's own page.
